revisions.evidence: source "inflict %0.2f mind damage (range 10), gaining psi and hate equal to 10%%%% of the damage done" 与 target "造成%0.2f精神伤害（距离10）……10%%%%的灵能值和仇恨值" 机制与数值一致
source "explode against your foes for %d cold damage (based on your Magic)" 与 target "自爆，造成%d寒冷伤害（基于魔法）" 一致
source "<20%%"/"50%% additional damage" 对应 target "生命值不足 20%%"/"多造成 50%%的伤害"，两个 %0.2f 顺序保持时空/物理
source "Extends the duration ... by %d%%" 与 "Current Extended Spell: %s" 对应 target "延展指定法术的持续时间 %d%%" 与 "当前强化法术： %s"
source "%d%% chance ... 100%% of the damage dealt as a bleed over 4 turns" 对应 target "%d%% 的几率……4 回合内受到 100%% 的额外流血伤害"
source "reducing their cooldowns and the power cost ... by %d%%" 与 "(%d disarm 'power', improves with Cunning)" 对应 target "冷却时间和能量消耗降低 %d%%" 与 "解除强度 %d，随灵巧提高"
source "Explodes (radius 2) for %0.2f fire damage over 3 turns" 对应 target "爆炸(范围 2) ：3回合内 %0.2f 火焰伤害"，数值与时限保留
source "disappear after %d turns or when their work is done" 对应 target "在 %d 回合后，或完成任务时消失"，潜行与伤害加成均保留
五个占位符顺序（半径 %d、伤害 %d、击退 %d、暴击伤害 %d%%、当前 %d%%）与 source "radius of %d ... %d damage and %d knockback ... by %d%% (currently: %d%%)" 一致，"dazed for 3 turns" 译为 "眩晕 3 回合"

revisions.observation: 条件绑定偏移：source 中 "if in line of sight" 限定的是粘液软泥怪须与目标有视线，target 把视线条件挪到了目标身上
revisions.evidence: source "Any Mucus Oozes you have active will, if in line of sight, instantly spit slime ... at one of the targets" vs target "则会向视线内的某个被淤泥击中的随机目标释放史莱姆喷吐"

revisions.observation: 作用对象弱化：source 明确只拉动敌人（foes），target 泛化为 "目标"，丢失仅敌方生效的范围限定
revisions.evidence: source "Pull all foes toward you in radius 5" vs target "将 5 码范围内的目标拉向你"

revisions.observation: 时态误译：source "have always been"（一直是）被译为 "曾是"（过去曾是，暗示现已不是），语义相反；具体六项属性被概括为 "所有强度和豁免" 属可接受概括
revisions.evidence: source "Halflings have always been a very organised and methodical race" vs target "半身人曾是一个有组织纪律的种族"
source "+%d Strength, +%d Dexterity, and +%d Constitution" 对应 target "%d 点力量、 %d 点敏捷和 %d 体质"，冷却与精神强度加成说明均保留
六个占位符（负重 %d、抛射物闪避 %d、定身 %d%%、震慑 %d%%、移速 %d%%、疲劳 %d）与 source 顺序一致，等级 4/5 条件保留
source "healing you for %d and generating %d mana ... below 1 life ... spellpower by %d for 10 turns" 对应 target "恢复 %d 生命值，获得 %d 法力值……生命值在 1 以下……法术强度 %d ，持续 10 回合"
source "foes and allies alike, doing %0.2f fire damage in a radius of %d each turn for %d turns" 对应 target "敌我双方造成 %0.2f 火焰伤害，半径 %d 码，持续 %d 回合"，占位符顺序一致
source 友方 "saves increased by %d ... healing factor +15%%" 与敌方 "saves reduced by %d ... cool down 15%% slower" 对应 target "提升 %d 魔法和物理豁免……治疗系数 15%%" 与 "降低 %d……冷却时间延长 15%%"
source "doing %d%% damage ... regain %d stamina" 对应 target "造成 %d%% 伤害……回复 %d 点体力"
source "global speed is increased by %d%% for 1 turn. Taking any action other than movement will break the effect" 对应 target "增加你 %d%% 全局速度 1 回合……除了移动外的任何动作均会打破此效果"

revisions.observation: OK（"natural obstacles" 译为 "其他障碍物" 丢失 "天然" 一词，但指代范围实质等同，属可接受）
revisions.evidence: source "passing through walls (but not natural obstacles), granting %d defense and %d armour" vs target "可以穿墙（但不能穿过其他障碍物），获得 %d 闪避和 %d 护甲值"
source "Improves/gives the ability to see invisible and stealthed creatures (power %d)" 对应 target "提升/获得侦测隐形或者潜行生物（ %d 侦测等级）"
source "reducing its stealth and invisibility power by %d, defense by %d and looses all evasion bonus from being unseen" 对应 target "减少 %d 潜行与隐身强度，减少 %d 闪避，同时失去不可见带来的闪避加成"
纯描述文本无占位符；source "only the toughest of them are able to gain the precious nutrients" 等关键内容在 target "只有最强壮的才能获得宝贵的营养变得更强" 中完整对应
source "His once-shining armour now dull and bloodstained ... given in to despair" 对应 target "曾经闪亮的盔甲如今又锈又钝且满是鲜血……陷入了深深的绝望"，"又锈又钝" 为轻微渲染，属风格范畴
